summary: Master strategic decision-making and risk management with this expert-led training. Gain the tools to make informed decisions and mitigate risks successfully.
lede: Risk-based decision-making combines strategic choices with structured assessment of uncertainty and threats to organizational objectives. It is designed for professionals responsible for organizational direction who need to assess risks and justify choices when planning investments or responding to changing conditions. Learners practice quantitative and qualitative risk assessment, use decision trees and sensitivity analysis to compare options, and develop scenario plans and mitigation responses.
audienceIntro: This program targets professionals responsible for steering organizational direction and managing the uncertainties inherent in complex business environments.
modules: Strategic Choice Architecture and Decision Trees
Digital Transformation and AI in Risk
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals with at least three years of experience in a management, analytical, or supervisory role. You should have a basic understanding of your organization's primary business model and operational objectives. No prior experience with advanced statistical software is required, though familiarity with spreadsheet-based data entry is beneficial. All necessary templates and frameworks, including ISO 31000 checklists and COSO ERM matrices, will be provided during the sessions.
